sentences.en: As is often the case with foreigners, John dislikes nattou.
sentences.zh: 像约翰这样的外国人通常都不喜欢纳豆。

sentences.en: A group of foreigners arrived in Edo, i.e. Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 一批外国人抵达了江户，也就是现在的东京。

sentences.en: He is a foreigner, as is evident from his accent.
sentences.zh: 从他的口音可以看出他是一个外国人。

senses.zh: 外国人,外人，陌生人,外来物，进口货物,（非本土的）外来动植物
